title: FBI Warns of ARTEX AI Hacking Tool in Global Attacks
excerpt: The FBI has issued a warning regarding ARTEX, an AI-powered penetration testing framework being used by hackers to automate global cyberattacks.
body_html:
The Federal Bureau of Investigation has issued a warning about a hacking tool known as ARTEX. According to the advisory, malicious actors are leveraging this artificial intelligence-driven penetration testing framework to automate cyberattacks against various organizations across the globe.

Among the incidents noted is a recent supply-chain breach involving ConnectWise. This specific attack resulted in the compromise of multiple Microsoft 365 customer environments. Security authorities continue to monitor the deployment of the framework as threat actors increasingly adopt automated capabilities for large-scale network intrusions.
